product.title: Product
product.appliesTo: Interfaces: the app, dashboards and tools

do.text: Keep what each screen or asset is for: its headline and its one action stay the most prominent things.
Visible focus on every control (a 2px White outline); touch targets at least 44px on phones.
Press feedback on pointer-down (scale 0.97 on buttons); no size changes on hover.

dont.text: Shadows, gradients other than the light, a colored ground, a second accent color, the spectrum as text color, bold (600+) weights, stretched, recolored, outlined, rotated or effected logos, the light inside a box with hard edges, filtered or graded photos, emoji, exclamation marks.

rules.text: Black is the ground. Surfaces are Black (#000000); a card is #171717 on Black with a 10px corner on the canvas (8px in the product). Separate with a fill or a #262626 hairline, never a shadow.
Type is White. Secondary text comes from the neutral steps (#BFBFBF, #A3A3A3); #4D4D4D and darker are never text. Pick grays from the 15 neutral steps, never by eye.
Most screens use only Black and White. The spectrum colors (Magenta, Red, Orange, Yellow, Green, Cyan, Blue) come from the brand light and small accents; when shown together they keep that order.

Funnel Display Regular for headlines, titles and subheadings (line height 1.07 at display sizes, 1.0 on card titles); DM Sans Regular for body and captions, DM Sans Medium for labels and buttons; labels in capitals with 6% letter spacing. Weights 400 and 500 only.

The primary button is a White fill with a Black DM Sans Medium label, 10px corner, 56px tall on the canvas (40px in the product). One primary button per view; secondary is a #262626 fill, ghost has no fill until hovered.
The search bar is a Black field with a hairline, the prompt in White DM Sans and a White "Search" button inside.

Motion is quick and quiet: 150ms color changes, 200ms entrances, exits faster, nothing over 300ms, never ease-in, hover only behind (hover: hover), reduced motion keeps opacity and color. Icons never move on hover.

website.title: Website and assets
website.appliesTo: Web pages, social posts, ads, decks, banners and merch

do.text: Keep what each screen or asset is for: its headline and its one action stay the most prominent things.
Visible focus on every control (a 2px White outline); touch targets at least 44px on phones.
Press feedback on pointer-down (scale 0.97 on buttons); no size changes on hover.

dont.text: Shadows, gradients other than the light, a colored ground, a second accent color, the spectrum as text color, bold (600+) weights, stretched, recolored, outlined, rotated or effected logos, the light inside a box with hard edges, filtered or graded photos, emoji, exclamation marks.

rules.text: The light (the brand pattern) is one shape drawn three times in Red #DF0000 at 0.85, Green #00FF29 at 0.782 and Blue #1B1DFF at 0.782, each offset sideways, blurred and blended plus-lighter on Black, so the colors separate at the edges and turn pale where they overlap. It flows in from the edges and corners of a layout, never boxed in, with a main mass and a smaller counterpart elsewhere.

The ASCII texture is a field of Geist Mono characters (" .:-=+*#") from a soft heat map, on Black, at 0.35 opacity, behind the light. It is an accent, never the main graphic, kept clear of text, the logo and photos, with soft edges.

Imagery is real creative (ads, product shots, UGC) in its posted color: no grading, filters or neon. Photos sit on Black with the light behind or between them. Examples and templates use Acme placeholders or supplied images, never another brand's photos or a real person's name.

Layouts: the lockup top left (or centered), the headline in Funnel Display, a White button bottom left and "spyglass.so" bottom right. Margins are 64px on ads, 72px on posts, 96px on decks (1080px and 1920px canvases).

Logo: the logomark (a rounded rectangle with a lens cut out), the 3D logomark, the wordmark, horizontal and vertical combination marks and the 3D combination marks. Primary background is Black with a White mark; secondary backgrounds are White (Black mark), Blue, Red and Magenta (White mark), Yellow and Green (Black mark).
